name: hextimator · hextimator

title.zh: hextimator · 从品牌色生成可接入项目的明暗

description.zh: 看首页Try it out代码与已生成的黄绿色主题。 hextimator从品牌HEX色生成明暗主题token，提供运行时主题库、在线playground、CLI及React/Tailwind接入。界面把预设、代码和色值输出并排呈现，适合多租户主题配置；自身固定版本源码按MIT许可，服务价格及生成内容的独立商用权限仍待核。
description.en: hextimator generates light and dark theme tokens from a brand hex color, with a runtime library, online playground, CLI and React/Tailwind integration. Presets, code and rendered values support multi-tenant theme configuration. Its fixed-version own source is MIT licensed; service pricing and separate permissions for generated content remain unverified.

Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by hextimator (https://hextimator.com/).
Technology stack: react, tailwind.
Component specification: 看首页Try it out代码与已生成的黄绿色主题。

Visual details from source observation: 我们先看首页品牌与主题用途，再到playground比较Default、Tinted、Muted、Bold、Vibrant五种预设入口；当前#ff6677对应的token已经渲染。首页Try it out另显示黄绿色主题，可对照代码与色值。本次只核现成界面，未测试改码、复制或对比度合规；自身源码MIT，输出与外部素材另核。
